title: Villagers block road and confront officials following fatal leopard attack in Pauri
seoTitle: Pauri road block over leopard attack

tea.why: Residents are protesting following a fatal leopard attack on a four-year-old child and perceived administrative inaction.
tea.want: Demonstrators are demanding effective safety measures against wildlife attacks and for the leopard to be killed.
tea.changed: Nov 4: Villagers blocked the Pauri-Devprayag road and temporarily confined local officials inside a shop.

summary: Residents in Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand, initiated protests after a leopard killed a four-year-old child near Khandyusain. On Tuesday, villagers surrounded local BJP MLA Rajkumar Pori's vehicle when he visited the area. The protests escalated on Wednesday as demonstrators staged a sit-in, blocking the Pauri-Devprayag motor road. Protesters accused the administration and the forest department of failing to prevent recurring wildlife attacks. During the demonstrations, villagers locked the Pauri Tehsildar and a forest department SDO inside a shop, though they were later released following interventions and talks with the Divisional Forest Officer. Authorities have assured residents of necessary security measures while discussions continue.
demands: Kill the leopard responsible for the attack
Implement effective safety measures against wildlife attacks
response: According to the sources, local MLA Rajkumar Pori assured villagers of security measures, and Divisional Forest Officer Mahatim Yadav held talks with the protesters. Police also rescued officials who had been confined by demonstrators.

updates.text: A four-year-old child was killed in a leopard attack near Khandyusain, prompting angry villagers to surround MLA Rajkumar Pori's vehicle.
Villagers blocked the Pauri-Devprayag road and temporarily confined local officials inside a shop before releasing them after talks with the DFO.
